Attempts the invoice due event batch (see batch_invoke_due_event()), limited to once per rolling 24-hour period. If that batch ran within the previous 24 hours, it falls back to dispatching the same due-date events directly so newly-eligible invoices are not missed for up to 24 hours. Either way, the built-in reminder handlers atomically claim each invoice via reminded_at before sending anything, so the same invoice is never reminded twice even across overlapping cron runs or repeated dispatch of the underlying events.
